high_level_description: This image is a promotional post for the movie "Bison" (Kaala Adan), which is set to release on October 17th. The poster features a man walking through a desolate landscape filled with the skulls of buffalo, suggesting a post-apocalyptic or dystopian setting. The man appears to be carrying a sack over his shoulder, possibly indicating he is a survivor or a traveler in a harsh environment. The text on the poster includes: "APPLAUSE ENTERTAINMENT & PA RANJITH PRESENT" "7 OCT 17TH IN CINEMAS WORLDWIDE"
